title: SQL injection: request parameter concatenated into the query string
description: username parameter from request.getParameter is spliced into Statement query with no escaping. Allows injection attacks like ?username=%25' UNION SELECT to break out of LIKE literal and dump arbitrary table contents.

title: Database credentials hardcoded in source
description: app_user and app_pass are literal strings compiled into artifact and committed to git. Production DB credentials exposed to anyone with repo access or built WAR; rotation requires code change and redeploy.

title: Admin endpoint performs no authorization check
description: Servlet at /api/admin/users/search returns user IDs and emails but never checks session, role, or token. Any unauthenticated caller can enumerate full user table.
